description: Returns one Crawlability Scan by id: its website, sitemap, status, dates and page counts (imported, approved, measured, not measured, dead, stale or missing last-modified dates, duplicates, linked but not in the sitemap), and once completed its run summary (results): whether robots.txt and llms.txt were read, the per-crawler roll-up of what robots.txt allows, how pages answered AI crawler identities compared with a browser, pages linked from the site that the sitemap does not list (up to 25 of each list, with the totals), and why a run stopped early if it did. results is null until the scan completes; on a completed scan whose stored results could not be read, results_unavailable is true and the results are in the Yellowhead app. A robots.txt that could not be read is reported as unknown, not as absent. The per-URL results are in the Yellowhead app.
name: get_crawlability_scan
title: Get a Crawlability Scan
